records.subject: Welcome aboard, Summit Ventures
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Your workspace for Summit Ventures is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days in, zero customer replies to three outbound emails (email:721e18eb, email:63dd0749, email:5a0d9da9), no tickets, and no project, invite, or milestone. Total silence plus all three stall reasons suggests low self-serve momentum, though 8 days remain and Starter setup is light, so not negligible.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

I know a new tool can sit untouched during a busy week, so no worries if Wrenfield hasn't had your attention yet. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is what makes everything else click. There's also an in-app onboarding flow that walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? Fifteen minutes and I can walk through setting up your first project with you, or answer questions over email if that's easier.

Best,
Chidi
